# Wyatt's Barbershop

> Old-school barbershop based in Austin, Texas. Classic cuts, sharp fades and hot towel straight razor shaves from four barbers in a vintage shop on E 7th St. Walk in or book your chair.

- Phone: (512) 351-9703
- Based in: Austin, TX
- Nearby areas: East Austin, Govalle, Holly, East Cesar Chavez, Mueller, Downtown Austin
- Booksy rating: 4.9 from 197 reviews
- Book an appointment: https://ronaks-code.github.io/sitelift-demos/barbershops/texas/wyatts-barbershop/quote.html
- Pick a time: https://ronaks-code.github.io/sitelift-demos/barbershops/texas/wyatts-barbershop/book.html

## Services
- Haircuts & fades: Classic cuts, skin and bald fades, tapers and side parts, finished with a straight razor shave on the neck.
- Beard trims: Shape-ups and full beard trims, on their own or with your cut.
- Hot towel shaves: The old-school straight razor shave: hot towels, a razor honed on a leather strop and lather from a badger brush.
- Head shaves: A clean, smooth head shave from a licensed barber.
- Buzz cuts: Quick, even clipper cuts. In the chair and back out the door.
- Senior cuts: Classic cuts for our senior customers, done with the same care as every other cut.

## About
Wyatt's Barbershop is an old-school barbershop at 3401 E 7th St, in the Govalle corner of East Austin. Inside it's vintage barber chairs, framed pictures on every wall, a classic soda machine and good music on the speakers: rock, blues and funk. Alex Caceres, Woody Aguilar, DC Heiser and Nick St Onge cut hair here in white barber jackets. Our Booksy reviews go back to 2021, and plenty of the people writing them have been coming to the same barber for years. It's a neighborhood shop. Walk in when a chair is open or book ahead online, pay cash (there's an ATM inside), and park in our own lot right out front. The bars and restaurants of East 7th are next door.

## Frequently asked questions
- Q: Do you take walk-ins?
  A: Yes. Walk-ins are welcome whenever a chair is open. If you want a set time with a specific barber, book online or call (512) 351-9703.
- Q: Do you take cards?
  A: No, Wyatt's is cash only. There is an ATM in the shop if you forget.
- Q: What comes with a haircut?
  A: Every haircut, fades and bald fades included, is finished with a straight razor shave on the back of the neck. Plan on about 30 minutes.
- Q: Where do I park?
  A: The shop has its own parking lot right out front at 3401 E 7th St, with easy access off E 7th St.
- Q: What are your hours?
  A: Monday to Friday 8 AM to 8 PM and Saturday 8 AM to 1 PM. Closed Sunday.
- Q: Do you cut kids' hair?
  A: Yes. Parents bring their kids in, from little ones to teens, and our barbers take the time to get it right.
